observer: arena sandbox page-fetch path (rendered play.hotspawn.com/lobby, the Hotspawn scheduled-fixture API and hltv.org/matches), not a GitHub runner. Byte-level SHA-256 of each response is therefore not recorded; the URLs and the observation time are.
role: Dated inventory, identity and coverage reconciliation only. Nothing in this file is a probability, a price or a pick, and it is never written into the priced ladder.

published_site.role: The snapshot this record compares against: it is the build deployed at 2026-10-25T23:03:48Z and the branch-root copy at commit cfd58e1.

hotspawn.note: The lobby rendered 19 open CS2 cards at 2026-10-26T00:44Z (Closing Soon and Upcoming), and the scheduled-fixture API carried the same 19 ids plus past-start rows that Hotspawn still reports with status 'scheduled'. limitations: This is one dated observation, not a live feed. A card scheduled later than 2026-10-26T00:44Z is not in this list.

The nine cards absent from the 23:03:48Z snapshot are absent because the deployed build predates them; this record cannot prove the minute they were scheduled on Hotspawn, only that the deployed build does not carry them and the live API does.

HLTV's per-match odds widget is rendered client-side; the fetched HTML exposes the ranking, form, stand-in, head-to-head and map-pool sections but no bookmaker decimal price. It is used for identity and research only, never as a probability.
Two Moscow Cyber Games cards (1082792, 1082793) had no HLTV match page located in the fetched upcoming list at this observation; they are left without an HLTV link rather than guessed.
Hotspawn crowd percentages, offered points and leaderboard positions are excluded from every probability in this project.
